# ms: # One session start and one successful turn with no tool, from process start.
# session_start carries ctx.hasUI=true, which is the gate this asset checks
# instead of Pi's ctx.mode. OMP sets hasUI from isInteractive || mode ===
# "rpc-ui" (src/main.ts:1830), so print, json and plain rpc are already false
# and the Pi asset's reason for preferring mode does not apply here. It carries
# no reason field at all: OMP's SessionStartEvent is {type} and nothing else,
# where Pi's has a reason. ctx.sessionFile and ctx.sessionId are both present, so
# the pane is bound to its transcript by path.
# THE LANE COMES FROM agent_start AND FROM THE DEBOUNCED IDLE agent_end ARMS.
# There is no agent_settled row and there never will be: OMP has no such event.
# What replaces Pi's isIdle guard is visible right here -- agent_end reports
# ctx.isIdle=FALSE on a turn that completed normally, so an asset that closed a
# turn the way Pi's does would never settle at all. The three guards this asset
# uses instead are agentActive, willContinue, and the 250ms debounce.
# willContinue is a payload key on every agent_end and its value is absent here:
# the field exists on the type and is only set when a continuation was scheduled,
# which is why the asset compares against an explicit true rather than testing
# for the key.
# turn_start and turn_end fire once each on a turn with no tool. See
# tool-turn-with-approval.tsv for the same pair firing twice inside one run.
